task: Creating a mosaic coaster with glass gems
query: How do I create a mosaic coaster with glass gems?

goal.title: Decorate a plate with clear and purple gems
goal.description: Trial-arrange clear and purple decorative gems on a blue-green plate, gather them again, then use hot glue to attach the central clear motif and purple pieces extending around it.
goal.final_state: Clear gems form a central motif with purple gems extending horizontally and vertically across the plate, which is lifted and displayed.
procedure: Position the plate and lay out the clear gems near its center.
Arrange purple gems around the clear pieces to test a cross-like pattern.
Gather the loose gems and prepare the hot-glue gun.
Glue and press the clear center pieces into position.
Glue the purple gems around the center, press the pieces, remove fine glue strands, and display the decorated plate.

phases.description: The plate is positioned on newspaper and clear decorative pieces placed and adjusted near its center.
Purple gems are spaced to either side, above, and below the center, then the loose pieces gathered again before gluing.
The glue gun is picked up and clear pieces are individually glued, placed, and held against the plate.
Purple gems are picked up one at a time, receive hot glue, and are pressed into the horizontal and vertical extensions around the clear center.
The glue gun is put down, individual gems pressed again, fine glue strands pulled away, and the plate lifted and tilted for inspection.
